title: Bad extension map
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $\{\pm1\}^n$. The bad extension map sends each coordinate restriction for which the restricted formula is nonconstant to the restriction obtained by fixing its first bad coordinate to its first bad required sign.
hypotheses_covered: input is a coordinate restriction for which the restricted formula is nonconstant
caveat: The referenced definitions of the first bad coordinate and first bad required sign are not supplied.
